name: Hedrons
description: The hedrons are massive runed stone formations made by Ugin, Sorin and Nahiri to lure, contain and immobilize the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

status.text: As of the latest story, glowing hedrons float in the rift at the Crucible on Tarkir, where Narset shows them to Elspeth.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only hedrons unchanged.
timeline.quote: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

citation.text: Harrow (Zendikar, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Deep underground, Ob Nixilis rotates the hedrons on the cavern walls and casts spells, testing their runes.
timeline.quote: He rotated a hedron a few degrees and spoke a brief incantation.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Ob Nixilis was drawn to Zendikar to purge a curse but was attacked and bound with a hedron by Nahiri, which stopped his curse but crippled him.
timeline.quote: I couldn't even scream as she bound the hedron into me.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reveals that the bound hedron took his power and that his wings fell off, leaving him small and weak, and vows revenge.
timeline.quote: The thing she put inside me made me small. Weak.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis studies the hedrons for centuries and lures planeswalkers, letting word of his condition spread until a proud planeswalker comes to extract the hedron.
timeline.quote: And sure enough, some arrogant child finally took my lure.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis says that heroes coming to fight the Eldrazi will need what he knows about the hedrons, and that he feels his spark within reach after Bala Ged's destruction.
timeline.quote: My spark is within reach.

citation.text: "Dreams of the Damned" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Over forty years, Nahiri pulls hedrons from the earth and Ugin etches them with runes, creating a trap and a lure for the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It took forty years of near-constant work.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Sorin and Ugin focus their power in the Eye of Ugin and shift every hedron into its final position, completing the network.
timeline.quote: Every single hedron on the plane glowed as they shifted into new positions.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills an Eldrazi monstrosity on Zendikar with a shard of hedron after a hard fight.
timeline.quote: Hedron connected with boney faceplate.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Naiva, her mind twisted by Bolas, holds a knife to Baishya's throat, then snaps out of it as the hedron's essence reaches her and Yasova disarms her.
timeline.quote: Why was she holding a blade against her sister's throat?

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova argues that destroying the hedrons would destroy Ugin's essence, the soul of Tarkir, so they must resist Bolas.
timeline.quote: I do not believe Bolas can destroy the hedrons.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Unwritten Now" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Nissa merges her magic with the Core, colliding with Nahiri's hedrons and flattening the Singing City.
timeline.quote: Nissa's magic merged with the Core's power.

citation.text: "Episode 5: The Two Guardians" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, compleated and with blades for hands, surveys the Phyrexian invasion from a floating stone and decides to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave in Emeria will be the perfect access point to connect the entire hedron networks

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Nahiri recounts converting or killing the elementals and pouring her joy, anger and grief into the hedron network until nothing is left.
timeline.quote: So, she channeled her pain, her grief from the betrayals, the losses, the loneliness over the millennia.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
timeline.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, Ugin and Sorin Markov use hedrons to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Together with Ugin and Sorin Markov she used them to trap the horrendous Eldrazi on the plane.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic and Nahiri's hedron network forms the prison bars.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane, directing their hunger to that unique mana

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin ally against the Eldrazi but cannot defeat them, and instead imprison them on Zendikar with a hedron network centered on the Eye of Ugin.
timeline.quote: Instead of killing the Eldrazi, they caused the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin returns, frees Anowon and goes with Nissa to the Eye, where Nissa shatters the main hedron, releasing the Eldrazi; Sorin leaves the plane.
timeline.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise a trap network of leylines, hedrons and mana nodes on Zendikar, with Nahiri building it and Ugin inscribing runes.
timeline.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons , and nodes of mana.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Three plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Sorin lures them, Ugin binds them and Nahiri builds the hedron prison.
timeline.quote: Nahiri constructed a massive network of stone hedrons

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn sends compleated Nahiri to conquer Zendikar; she reactivates the Emeria Skyclave and realigns the hedrons to call Realmbreaker, fusing with the stones.
timeline.quote: she fused herself with the stones in the center, becoming its keystone

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ancient planeswalkers use the hedrons to lure, contain and immobilize the Eldrazi, who remain trapped for millennia.
timeline.quote: Unable to defeat the titans, the ancient Planeswalkers used the hedrons to lure, contain, and immobilize them.

citation.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin lures the Eldrazi, Ugin binds them with colorless magic, and Nahiri builds the hedron network that forms their prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov lured the Eldrazi to the plane

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri repairs the hedron network, slays Zhulodok and returns the Eldrazi to slumber.
timeline.quote: Nahiri slew Zhulodok and sealed the Eldrazi in their hedronic prison again

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The first awakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa raises hedrons around Ulamog and Jace activates them, trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: Jace activated the hedrons' magic, and Ulamog was trapped!

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis slaughters the Kor guards, siphons the hedrons' power to reignite his spark, destroys the network and awakens Kozilek.
timeline.quote: he destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
